#### Bug description

The analyzer does not work if SuppressSourceGeneration = true. This has happened since version 3.1.1. It still worked in 3.1.0.

agent.summary: Could not reproduce the regression on this branch. Analyzer code paths report diagnostics regardless of SuppressSourceGeneration, and the generator is gated separately via IsGeneratingSource. I added one passing regression-guard test (MsgPack004 under suppression) but made no source change, so the 'test fails without change' requirement is not met. git history comparison with 3.1.0 was blocked by the sandbox.
